719-2556-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-2556-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

803-1486-4231-5361--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1556-2645-3181-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
1556-2645-3181-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3360-3430-6723.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4478-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4478-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-3197-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

803-3413-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

851-2457-2757.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

465-670-1619-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6147.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Rilsa Rael from exile to the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

3532-5078-7693-7736.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-7693-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

147-5686-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-5686-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

204-1858-2056-2633-4478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-4478.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

2060-2908-6930-7183.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {U}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

539-5231-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3761-5078-5705.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

1402-1879-2644-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-2459-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

280-1399-1606-2957.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

222-2060-2921-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 4 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2060-2921-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2060-2921-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1263-2060-5256-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-5256-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

4125-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Shipwreck Dowser.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
4125-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, causing you to mill cards equal to Shipwreck Dowser's power.
Cast Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1223-2511.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-2511.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.

301-2921-5643.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-2921-5643.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1656-2222-4762.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-2222-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Auriok Bladewarden's ability by tapping it, giving it +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once Necrotic Ooze has infinite toughness, you may instead use Devoted Druid's first ability to get infinite green mana.

606-1548-4345-4941-4946.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
606-1548-4345-4941-4946.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast True Polymorph by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing Port Razer to become a copy of Eye of Vecna.
Activate The Book of Vile Darkness by tapping it and exiling it, Port Razer and Hand of Vecna, causing you to create a legendary 8/8 Vecna token that has all triggered abilities of the exiled cards.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using Vecna.
Vecna triggers, causing you to untap each creature you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

1150-2018-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Melira's Keepers.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2445-4204.description:
Activate Varolz by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, regenerating Varolz.
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability by paying {3} and exiling it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2438-2577-3260-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your storm count is at least one.
Your life total is at least three.
2438-2577-3260-4740.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik triggers.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use it to activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2440-4720-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Cat creatures.
2440-4720-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Whitemane Lion's trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Stonework Packbeast any number of times.
